_comment: SurveyJS bid form for a Deed — anchored as {id}#bco (type: bidContributor) on the
PROTOCOL entity, not on the Deed. Changing it affects every collection pointing at
that protocol; establish the blast radius first.
TWO TESTS every field must pass (control C10):
1. NECESSARY  — it feeds an eligibility rule or a safeguarding control.
'Useful for reporting' is not a rule. Cut it.
2. ANSWERABLE — a youth in the target group can answer truthfully, now,
without documents they do not have.
Approving a bid grants /ixo.claims.v1beta1.SubmitClaimAuthorization on the collection.
This form is the input to an authorization decision, not a registration.
FIELDS THAT USUALLY FAIL: formal residential address, bank details, national ID,
CV or qualifications, employer reference, free-text motivation essay. Each excludes
by resource access rather than by suitability.
Delete every field below that no rule consumes. Translate into access.languages —
title: <<<Apply for: opportunity name>>>
description: <<<One sentence: what you are applying to do.>>>
completedHtml: Application sent. <<>>

elements.name: preferred_name
elements.title: What should we call you?
elements._note: Preferred name, not legal name. Legal name is rarely needed to apply.

elements.name: age_band
elements.title: How old are you?
elements._necessary_for: consent capacity (control C12) and safeguarding tier (control C4)
elements._note: Keep as a band unless a rule genuinely needs an exact date of birth.

elements.name: guardian_contact
elements.title: A parent or guardian's contact
elements._necessary_for: guardian consent where the tier requires it
elements._note: DELETE THIS FIELD if the Deed is 18+ only. Never collect it speculatively.

pages.name: can_you_reach_it
pages.title: Can you take part?
pages._note: These exist so nobody is approved into an opportunity they cannot reach.

elements.name: district
elements.title: Which area are you in?
elements._note: Never ask for a formal street address — it excludes informal settlements.

elements.name: device
elements.title: What will you use to take part?
choices: A basic phone (calls and texts only)
A smartphone I borrow or share
elements._note: 'Borrow or share' matters — a shared device cannot hold a long session.

elements.name: languages
elements.title: Which languages do you read comfortably?

elements.name: task_capability
elements.title: <<<Stated as a TASK, never as a credential>>>
elements.description: <<<e.g. 'Have you planted a tree before?' — not 'Do you hold a horticulture certificate?'>>>
choices: No, but I want to learn
elements._note: 'No, but I want to learn' should usually still be eligible. If it is not, say why.

elements.name: accessibility_needs
elements.title: Is there anything we should arrange so you can take part?
elements._note: Optional and open. Never used to exclude — only to arrange.

elements.name: consent
elements.title: Before you send this

choices.text: <<<Name exactly what is collected, who sees it, and when it is deleted.>>>
<<<I have read what I need to submit and what gets a claim rejected.>>>

_note: Consent must not be bundled. A youth must be able to take part without agreeing
to unrelated processing (control C12 critical fail).
Under-18 applicants: this is ASSENT. Guardian consent is captured separately and
verified — assent does not replace it, and it does not replace assent.
